summary: Built an agentic API security testing platform over an 8-week internship. Instead of static test scripts, the system reads an API spec, reasons about it, and writes its own security-focused test cases.
points: Designed a closed observe–analyze–regenerate loop in LangGraph with PostgreSQL-backed state checkpointing, so the system checks its own test coverage and generates more targeted tests in each reasoning cycle.
Built a two-pass HTTP execution engine that captures runtime authentication and setup context before running dependent test cases, removing the need to hardcode an auth flow for every endpoint.

Integrated Gemini models through LiteLLM with few-shot prompt libraries to generate structured test cases across OWASP API security categories: BOLA, authentication bypass, injection and mass assignment.
Deduplicated generated test payloads at the database level using SHA-256 canonicalization in PostgreSQL.
Set up a GitHub Actions CI pipeline that lints, type-checks and runs tests on every push and pull request.
